requirements_summary: Workload: high-throughput reranking + low-latency chat bursts
Throughput target: sustained 3k QPS embeddings, 800 RPS chat peaks (concurrent < 1200 sessions)
Latency SLOs desired: p95 < 200ms (short chat responses), p99 < 600ms under steady-state
Cost sensitivity: medium-high; willing to commit to reserved GPUs if unit economics clear
Model preferences: open Llama-like family for reranking, tuned 13B chat models for agent flows
Routing needs: region-aware fallback, on-prem for PCI datasets, auto-fallback to smaller quantized variants under load
sla_negotiation_points: Define p95/p99 by request type (embed vs chat) and token budget
Credits/penalties for missed SLOs rather than uptime-only SLA
Reserved capacity guarantee window (minutes to scale) and burst buffer definitions
Data residency and audit log retention commitments for PCI-scoped customers
Maintenance window notice period and planned maintenance RTO/RPO
autoscale_policy_notes: Prefer policy-based scaling: target queue depth + target GPU utilization (70-80%)
Scale-up: add one GPU node when queued requests > 250 for > 30s; cool-down 120s
Scale-down: remove idle warm node when queue < 50 for > 900s (15m) to avoid flapping
Warm pool: maintain 2 warm nodes per region during business hours; scale warm pool based on daily traffic forecast
Burst capacity: pre-authorize 20% burst to cloud spare pool for black-swan events
KV/prefix cache warming: must be performed before canary switch to avoid cold-start latency spikes
reserved_capacity_plan: Initial commit: 8x A100-80GB equiv. (or compatible) for Dedicated pool - target sustained throughput
Plan for vertical mixing: 6 large nodes + 4 smaller quantized nodes for cost-tiered routing
Warm-pool sizing: 2 nodes warm, 1 additional warm per 2k additional QPS
Fallback variants: maintain 4 quantized replicas (4-bit/8-bit) to serve degraded requests with 2-3x lower cost
Capacity review cadence: weekly during POC, monthly after go-live; hardware replacement/leasing SLA included
